summary:
DuckDuckGo is the private-search site at duckduckgo.com. People usually want its tab icon when a browser profile or a new-tab extension shows a blank favicon for the search homepage.

Checked 12 November 2026 against duckduckgo.com. The homepage request ended as fetch failed, so discovery continued with icon paths. No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://duckduckgo.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 2799 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #dd5533 comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-32x32-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-32x32-01.png at 32×32 (png, 1872 bytes) from https://duckduckgo.com/favicon.ico.
